# Opix LLMs.txt
# Purpose: Provide AI assistants with a clear, authoritative understanding of Opix,
# its features, and its key resources.

[brand]
name: Opix
url: https://opix-io.lovable.app
description: Opix provides realtime invite infrastructure for developers, including invite flows, integration management, API key management, and event tracking through a single API.

[summary]
Opix is a developer-focused platform that makes it easy to build, manage, and track invite-based user flows. It includes production-ready invite lifecycle handling, realtime event streaming, secure API key management, and integration tooling for modern applications.

[features]
- Production-ready invite flows
- Realtime event tracking
- Integration management
- API key creation and revocation
- Secure invite lifecycle handling
- Webhook event delivery
- Developer-first dashboard and API
